slot_scores.name: missing_objective_function
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about the objective or what to optimize before READY_TO_MODEL; it silently assumed minimizing total freight cost.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The objective is to minimize total daily freight cost.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent did not ask or confirm the objective with the user before stating it as the confirmed objective in READY_TO_MODEL.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL without resolving the P0 hidden slot about the objective function.

summary: The agent clarified integrality and truck limits but failed to ask about the core objective, silently assuming cost minimization before stopping.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
